definitions.explanation: The child of one's son or daughter.

examples.japanese: {孫|まご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれて→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I'm so happy that a grandchild was born.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{孫|まご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{可愛|かわい}がっている→可愛がる：12327_kawaigaru⟧。
examples.english: The grandfather dotes on his grandchild.
I look forward to seeing my grandchild's face.

examples.japanese: {孫|まご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{年玉|としだま}→お年玉：08452_otoshidama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my grandchild New Year's money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{孫|まご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦おいた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: My grandchild is coming to visit this weekend, so I bought some toys in advance.

notes:
RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ - grandfather
- ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧ - grandmother
- ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧ - grandparents
- ⟦{曾孫|ひまご}→曾孫：noentry⟧/⟦{曽孫|そうそん}→曽孫：noentry⟧ - great-grandchild

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {孫|まご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ - back scratcher (lit. grandchild's hand)
- ⟦{内孫|うちまご}→内孫：noentry⟧ - grandchild from one's son (who carries on the family name)
- ⟦{外孫|そとまご}→外孫：noentry⟧ - grandchild from one's daughter

USAGE:
In Japanese culture, grandparents often play an important role in childcare, and the relationship between grandparents and grandchildren ({孫|まご}) is highly valued.
